description: Hosted Solid pod providers (census of solidproject.org/get_a_pod) and configurable closed-source deployments. Live, credentials from the environment; missing configuration is UNTESTED.

source.commitSubject: Add missing Pod providers to Get a Pod (#979)

alsoConsulted.finding: links to /get_a_pod and mentions Inrupt; lists no additional hosted providers

census.method: read-only GET of each provider's /.well-known/openid-configuration (and HEAD/GET of the listed registration page for headers) from a macOS workstation; no accounts, no authenticated requests

targets.name: brolly.id (hosted Solid pod provider listed at solidproject.org/get_a_pod)
notes: software: discovery served by 'railway-hikari', site by Vercel; the server software is not disclosed (inferred from response headers, not stated by the provider)
discovery 2026-09-27: issuer https://brolly.id (no trailing slash); solid_oidc_supported advertised; issuer host brolly.id, not www.brolly.id (www answers 404 for discovery)

client registration (discovery 2026-09-27): a registration_endpoint is advertised, so dynamic registration works without a hosted Client Identifier Document; no provider advertises Client Identifier Document support in its metadata (Solid-OIDC defines no such field), so the optional CLIENT_ID path is unverified here until a run
unattended (session mode): unverified — depends on whether the provider shows a login or consent page for a stored session; the non-interactive login fails closed if one appears

env.name: RA_INTEROP_BROLLY_ID_WEBID
env.description: WebID of a dedicated test account on brolly.id

env.name: RA_INTEROP_BROLLY_ID_STORAGE
env.description: storage root of the test account (ends with /)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_BROLLY_ID_SCRATCH
env.description: container dedicated to test writes inside the storage (ends with /); omit for read-only runs

env.name: RA_INTEROP_BROLLY_ID_PRIVATE_RESOURCE
env.description: an existing private resource of the test account (read-only runs)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_BROLLY_ID_OTHER_PROTECTED
env.description: a protected resource outside the test storage (read-only boundary probe)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_BROLLY_ID_ISSUER
env.description: override the expected issuer (defaults to the observed one)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_BROLLY_ID_STORAGE_STATE
env.description: Playwright storageState file of a dedicated test account's signed-in identity-provider session (contains cookies; never commit). With --headed it seeds the browser; without --headed it enables the fail-closed non-interactive session mode (a configured file that does not exist is a configuration error)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_BROLLY_ID_CLIENT_ID
env.description: optional Solid-OIDC Client Identifier Document URL (https, publicly dereferenceable, its redirect_uris must include the redirect URI); omit to use dynamic registration

env.name: RA_INTEROP_SOLID_REDIRECT_URI
env.description: loopback redirect URI (default http://127.0.0.1:39398/callback); with a Client Identifier Document it must be one of the document's redirect_uris

capabilityNotes.refreshRotation: whether refresh tokens rotate can only be observed with a test account (not yet run)

capabilityNotes.storageDiscovery: whether a private resource's 401 carries storage-root evidence (Link headers) can only be observed with a test account (not yet run)
